presented_event_with_attribution: Ramesh says: “Ji sir, main bas ek minute. Ghar wale ka phone aaya tha, unhe bol ke aata hoon. Aap aaram se khaayein, main turant wapas aa jaunga.” He glances at the phone in his pocket, nods once, and turns to leave the room.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: Ramesh, before breakfast: does the estate office work on Sundays, and when does the dhobi come this week? I must settle the file on Monday and the bill on Saturday.

typed_records.speaker: Ramesh
typed_records.words: Office band hai aaj, sir, Monday ko aap aayenge toh kholenge. Dhobi kal subah aayega, ek din pehle aa raha hai is hafte.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: Very good, Ramesh. Then breakfast at seven, and after it I shall walk in the garden while the air is clear. Keep the dhobi’s bill ready for tomorrow, and let me see it before he leaves.

typed_records.speaker: Ramesh
typed_records.words: Haan sir, chhaay ke baad main garden ki side khol dunga. Dhobi ka bill main abhi apke study table par rakhta hoon, aap subah check kar lein.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: Bahut accha, Ramesh. I shall look at the bill after breakfast; the garden side may wait until the shade is gone.

typed_records.speaker: Ramesh
typed_records.words: Ji sir. Aloo paratha garam hai, curd aur achaar bhi table par hai. Aap aaram se khaayein.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: Bahut accha, Ramesh. Leave it as it is; I shall take it slowly, and you may sit if you are not wanted elsewhere.

typed_records.speaker: Ramesh
typed_records.words: Ji sir, main bas ek minute. Ghar wale ka phone aaya tha, unhe bol ke aata hoon. Aap aaram se khaayein, main turant wapas aa jaunga.
